parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true: `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveRelease` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package: Metadata) and `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveArtist` in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package: app:iOS). These are mock helper methods living inside test targets, and their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.71) is incidental to their role as test doubles for distinct entity-resolution operations (release vs. artist). Collapsing them into a shared generic function would couple two separate test packages and obscure the domain distinction between the two mock behaviours.
